description.value:
You attempt to drag a willing or unconscious creature or an object. Attempt an @Check[athletics] check. If half the creature or object’s total bulk (including equipment that is carried) is equal to or less than your bulk limit, you can never get a result below a success. The DC of the check is typically equal to the bulk of the creature or object.

Critical Success You move yourself and the target a distance in a single direction equal to your speed.

Success You move yourself and the target a distance in a single direction equal to half your speed.

Failure You drag the creature or object and move yourself five feet.

Critical Failure You fail to drag the creature or object.
